args: In libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_rnglists.c, analyze _dwarf_internal_read_rnglists_header and its callers. What bounds invariant should be enforced for the encoded DWARF initial length given a contribution starting at offset, including 32/64-bit initial-length bytes? Identify existing error conventions/constants suitable for rejecting a contribution whose total size exceeds the remaining .debug_rnglists section.

The supplied ASan report shows a heap OOB read at read_single_rle_entry line 112, reached through dwarf_get_rnglist_rle after _dwarf_internal_read_rnglists_header accepts a malformed header. Existing validation reportedly checks only arealen > sectionlength, then computes total length as arealen + offset_size + extension_size and contribution end from offset. The PoV makes that end one byte beyond the section. I am investigating the precise local types, macros, and preferred error return before applying a minimal root-cause patch in libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_rnglists.c.
